title: 中高生の学校生活
subject_en: Japanese junior-high and high-school students in uniforms (blazers, sailor-collar or ties, dark trousers or skirts), mixed boys and girls, each ONE scene with two or three students, loose hand-drawn style, dot eyes, no school logos. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: 登校・授業・部活・文化祭・修学旅行など、制服姿の中高生の場面12点です。学校案内や教材、Webコンテンツに使えます。
items: two students walking to school with school bags on a tree-lined street
students sitting at desks in a classroom while the teacher writes on a board
three students chatting around a desk during a break

students sweeping and wiping desks in the classroom after school
a student frowning over an exam paper at a desk
a student running on a track in a gym uniform at dawn
two students reading and choosing books in a library
students painting a large signboard and carrying decorations
students walking along an old temple street with a guide flag
students standing to greet the teacher at the start of the day
two students walking home together under an evening sky
